description: The audit firehose, stacked by band. Signal is what the forensic dashboards show.

text.expr: length(data('rows')) ? '' : 'No activity for this selection in this time range'

axis.labelFont: "Elastic UI Numeric", Inter, "system-ui", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

url.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS n = COUNT(*) BY ts = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend), attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action, attributes.event.action, kib_internal = (attributes.event.action IN ("saved_object_open_point_in_time","saved_object_close_point_in_time","space_get","space_find") OR (attributes.event.action == "http_request" AND attributes.url.original IS NOT NULL AND attributes.url.original RLIKE "https?://[^/]+(/s/[^/]+)?/((internal|translations|app)/.*|api/content_management/rpc/(get|search|mget|bulkGet).*|bootstrap(-anonymous)?[.]js.*|api/(core|licensing|banners|ui_counters)/.*|api/spaces/space([?].*)?)") OR (attributes.event.action IN ("saved_object_get","saved_object_resolve","saved_object_find") AND attributes.kibana.saved_object.id IS NOT NULL AND attributes.kibana.saved_object.id LIKE "cloud-audit-*")) | EVAL band = CASE(attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action IN ("cluster:monitor/main", "elastic.maintenance"), "infra-noise", attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/search*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/msearch*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/scroll*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/*point_in_time" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action == "indices:data/read/open_reader_context" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/esql*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:admin/esql/*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/field_caps*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/async_search/*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:admin/resolve/*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action == "indices:admin/shards/search_shards" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "cluster:monitor/xpack/esql/*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action IN ("cluster:monitor/project/tags", "cluster:monitor/xpack/inference/get"), "query-noise", kib_internal, "query-noise", attributes.event.action == "connection_granted", "query-noise", attributes.event.action == "authentication_success", "authn-volume", "signal") | STATS events = SUM(n) BY ts, band | EVAL band = CASE(band == "signal", "Signal", band == "authn-volume", "Auth success", band == "query-noise", "Query internals", "Infra health") | EVAL t0 = TO_DATETIME(?_tstart), t1 = TO_DATETIME(?_tend) | SORT ts ASC

transform.calculate: datum.need <= 1e3 ? 1e3 : datum.need <= 5e3 ? 5e3 : datum.need <= 1e4 ? 1e4 : datum.need <= 3e4 ? 3e4 : datum.need <= 6e4 ? 6e4 : datum.need <= 3e5 ? 3e5 : datum.need <= 6e5 ? 6e5 : datum.need <= 18e5 ? 18e5 : datum.need <= 36e5 ? 36e5 : datum.need <= 108e5 ? 108e5 : datum.need <= 432e5 ? 432e5 : datum.need <= 864e5 ? 864e5 : datum.need <= 6048e5 ? 6048e5 : datum.need <= 2592e6 ? 2592e6 : datum.need <= 7776e6 ? 7776e6 : 31536e6

axis.labelExpr: length(data('rows')) && datum.index > 0 && datum.value > toDate(data('rows')[0].t1) - 0.06 * (toDate(data('rows')[0].t1) - toDate(data('rows')[0].t0)) ? '' : datum.index == 0 || (hours(datum.value) == 0 && minutes(datum.value) == 0) ? [timeFormat(datum.value, '%H:%M'), timeFormat(datum.value, '%B %d, %Y')] : timeFormat(datum.value, '%H:%M')

values.expr: split(slice((indexof(pluck(data('rows'), 'band'), 'Signal') >= 0 ? '|Signal' : '') + (indexof(pluck(data('rows'), 'band'), 'Auth success') >= 0 ? '|Auth success' : '') + (indexof(pluck(data('rows'), 'band'), 'Query internals') >= 0 ? '|Query internals' : '') + (indexof(pluck(data('rows'), 'band'), 'Infra health') >= 0 ? '|Infra health' : ''), 1), '|')
